title: Imitate no real or existing voice
statement: A generated narration voice never imitates a real person's voice or an existing character's voice.
detail: Two handover documents for a generated storyteller rule out imitating any existing voice, whether a real person's or a character's, and one adds that no spoken performance may be invented before it has been generated and heard. The narration handoff limits a reference to an animated series to the opening's narrative structure only.

evidence.quote: Avoid imitating any existing actor or character voice.
Do not imitate an actor or invent a spoken performance that has not been generated and heard.
Avoid an exaggerated trailer voice that obscures meaning, robotic list delivery, childish enthusiasm, or an actor imitation.
The *Avatar: The Last Airbender* reference describes the opening's narrative structure only.
